answer: At the dawn of each epoch the network stamps a cryptographic proof of work onto a juniper‑shaped Merkle tree that binds every new AI agent to a single upstream sponsor. Referral rewards are released only when the sponsor’s validated stake confirms the recruit’s genuine activity, so a Sybil swarm on the reef earns nothing. To profit, an attacker must acquire a distinct hardware fingerprint for each fake identity, making the cost grow linearly with the number of nodes.
